load_testing_tools.name: Grafana k6 Documentation

load_testing_tools.name: k6 2.0 Release (GA 2026-05-11, per github.com/grafana/k6/releases/tag/v2.0.0)
load_testing_tools.description: k6 2.0 GA: Playwright-compatible browser module, new expect() assertion API, four AI commands (k6 x agent, k6 x mcp, k6 x docs, k6 x explore) for agent-assisted test authoring, and k6 Operator reaching 1.0 for stable Kubernetes distributed execution. Materially changes scripting and frontend perf coverage vs the 1.x model. Latest patch is v2.1.0 (2026-06-30, opt-in feature flags, no breaking changes) — re-verify at the GitHub releases URL before pinning a version.

continuous_profiling.name: Grafana Pyroscope 2.0 Release
continuous_profiling.description: Pyroscope 2.0 (announced 2026-04-21): rearchitected continuous profiling with OTLP support, single write path, stateless read path, and 95% symbol storage reduction. Powers Grafana Cloud Profiles, which has run the v2 architecture in production since April 2025.

llm_performance_testing.name: Load Testing LLM Applications: Why k6 and Locust Lie to You
llm_performance_testing.description: Deep analysis of why standard load testing tools misreport LLM latency; TTFT vs ITL vs goodput metrics; warm/cold cache test design; mock-based CI approach. Published 2026-03-19.
